---
pagetitle: "`r source(here::here('R/legislature/session.R')); p <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(ga_paths(resolve_ga(params$ga))$people_json, paste0(params$people_id, '.json')))$person; n <- stringr::str_replace_all(p$name, ' And ', ' and '); paste(if (p$role == 'Sen') 'Senate' else 'House', n, if (!grepl('Committee$', n)) 'Committee')`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: false

params:
  people_id: 7061
  ga: null  # General Assembly; null = CURRENT_GA
---

```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))

ga <- resolve_ga(params$ga)
```

```{r}
# Read committee data from people JSON
committee_data <- read_json(file.path(ga_paths(ga)$people_json, paste0(params$people_id, ".json"))) |>
  pluck("person")

# Read related data
bills <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
sponsors <- read_csv(ga_csv("sponsors", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
rollcalls <- read_csv(ga_csv("rollcalls", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Determine chamber
chamber_name <- if (committee_data$role == "Sen") "Senate" else "House"
committee_name <- committee_data$name
committee_id <- committee_data$committee_id
display_name <- str_replace_all(committee_name, " And ", " and ")

referred_bills <- bills |>
  filter(committee_id == !!committee_id) |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date))

sponsored_bills <- sponsors |>
  filter(people_id == params$people_id) |>
  left_join(bills, by = "bill_id") |>
  arrange(desc(last_action_date))

# Match rollcalls where the description names the committee:
# "{Chamber} {Committee Name} Report". The people record and the vote
# descriptions disagree on "&" vs "And" (Senate Ways & Means), so either
# matches either
name_pattern <- str_replace_all(committee_name, regex("\\s+(and|&)\\s+", ignore_case = TRUE), " (and|&) ")
vote_pattern <- str_glue("{chamber_name}.*{name_pattern}.*Report")

committee_votes <- rollcalls |>
  filter(str_detect(description, regex(vote_pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))) |>
  left_join(bills |> select(bill_id, bill_number, title), by = "bill_id") |>
  arrange(desc(date))
```

```{r}
fmt_date <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%b %e, %Y"))
plural <- \(n, word) paste(format(n, big.mark = ","), if (n == 1) word else paste0(word, "s"))

div(class = "ia-card",
  div(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow-row",
    span(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow", toupper(paste(chamber_name, "committee")))
  ),
  h1(class = "ia-bill-title", display_name),
  div(class = "ia-bill-meta",
    span(plural(nrow(referred_bills), "bill"), " referred"),
    span(plural(nrow(sponsored_bills), "bill"), " sponsored"),
    span(plural(nrow(committee_votes), "committee vote"))
  )
)
```

```{r}
bill_prefix <- bill_dir_href(ga, up = 2)
# clean_bill_title() takes one title at a time
short_title <- \(title) map_chr(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title)

# Searchable, paged list of bills. The bill column holds "HF 123" so the
# search box matches what readers see; the cell renders the link
bill_col <- function(df) {
  reactable::colDef(
    name = "Bill", minWidth = 80, sortable = FALSE, html = TRUE,
    cell = function(value, index)
      sprintf('<a href="%s%s.html">%s</a>', bill_prefix, df$bill_number[index], value)
  )
}
date_col <- \(name) reactable::colDef(name = name, minWidth = 110,
                                      cell = \(value) if (is.na(value)) "—" else fmt_date(value))

bill_list <- function(df, empty) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(ui_empty(empty))
  df <- df |>
    transmute(
      bill_number,
      bill = str_replace(bill_number, "^([A-Z]+)(\\d+)$", "\\1 \\2"),
      title = short_title(title),
      status_desc,
      last_action,
      last_action_date
    )
  reactable::reactable(
    df,
    columns = list(
      bill_number = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
      bill = bill_col(df),
      title = reactable::colDef(name = "Title", minWidth = 260, sortable = FALSE),
      status_desc = reactable::colDef(name = "Status", minWidth = 100),
      last_action = reactable::colDef(name = "Last action", minWidth = 220, sortable = FALSE),
      last_action_date = date_col("Date")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(last_action_date = "desc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
}
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.panel-tabset}

## Bills referred

```{r}
bill_list(referred_bills, "No bills have been referred to this committee.")
```

## Bills sponsored

```{r}
bill_list(sponsored_bills, "This committee has not sponsored any bills.")
```

## Committee votes

```{r}
if (nrow(committee_votes) == 0) {
  ui_empty("No committee votes recorded.")
} else {
  votes_df <- committee_votes |>
    transmute(
      bill_number,
      bill = str_replace(bill_number, "^([A-Z]+)(\\d+)$", "\\1 \\2"),
      title = short_title(title),
      date,
      yea, nay,
      # Absent and not voting, as the journals record them
      not_voting = nv + absent
    )
  reactable::reactable(
    votes_df,
    columns = list(
      bill_number = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
      bill = bill_col(votes_df),
      title = reactable::colDef(name = "Title", minWidth = 280, sortable = FALSE),
      date = date_col("Date"),
      yea = reactable::colDef(name = "Yea", minWidth = 60, align = "right"),
      nay = reactable::colDef(name = "Nay", minWidth = 60, align = "right"),
      not_voting = reactable::colDef(name = "Not voting", minWidth = 90, align = "right")
    ),
    defaultSorted = list(date = "desc"),
    searchable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    highlight = TRUE
  )
}
```
